title: Add commit history and revision comparison
description: Make commit history and revision diffs available as a core desktop-style workflow while preserving the current working tree.
acceptanceCriteria: Users can browse paginated commit history and inspect commit metadata and changed paths.
Comparing revisions uses Git/API evidence and labels added, modified, deleted, and renamed paths only when supported.
Historical inspection cannot silently replace or mix the active branch's local working-tree state.
History loading, inaccessible revisions, and pagination failures preserve the current workspace.

steps.description: Read history and revision consistency contracts
steps.details: History and comparisons use the selected server-managed workspace and explicit revisions.

steps.description: Implement bounded history and compare views
steps.details: Added paginated immutable commit metadata and evidence-backed name-status comparisons.

steps.description: Test revision identity and failure paths
steps.details: Focused tests cover pagination, changed paths, and preservation of active HEAD state.

technicalNotes: Do not infer rename semantics without evidence.
